content.comment_body: I am experiencing an issue with a [product_name] [article_no] where the device is stuck on the input and output screen and will not respond to arrow keys for stopping or modifying the program. The only way to access further options is by pressing ESC and OK together, which brings up the clock and parameter settings.

Hello, The [product_name] [article_no] is quite an old version. However, you can download manuals for all versions from the [company_name] website. Visit: [url] Technical information is available on the right side. I hope this is helpful.

According to the manual: Earlier versions up to [article_no], with or without display, automatically switch to PC mode by doing the following: 1. Turn off the power supply to the [product_name]. 2. Remove the cover or program module (card) and connect the cable to the socket. 3. Turn on the power. The device will switch to PC mode and can be accessed by your computer. For further details, refer to the [product_name] software online help. You need to connect the cable before powering on to ensure the program stops in older versions.

analysis.insight_summary: Users face responsiveness issues with legacy [product_name] devices, particularly difficulties in stopping or modifying programs directly on the hardware interface. There is uncertainty regarding recovery methods and reliance on searching for technical documentation. The core challenge centers on usability and control access in older hardware designs.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear and accessible device-level methods for stopping and modifying programs, along with easy-to-find instructions for recovery if the device becomes locked.
